parameters.content:
## LANE 1 - Application Intake (v1.0)
**Form → Read Config → Build record (knockout check) → Save PDF to Drive → Extract text → Duplicate check → Save row to Candidates → Audit Log**

_Knockouts are Yes/No form answers, never AI guesses. Knockout fails and duplicates are FLAGGED for a human, never auto-rejected. Every event is written to the Audit Log._

## CLIENT SETUP (one-time)
1. Copy the Google Sheet template and paste its URL into **SETUP - Paste Your Sheet URL** (also set `fallback_alert_email`). All 10 Sheets nodes read it from there.
2. Connect 4 credentials: Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, OpenRouter.
3. Edit the job, rubric, thresholds and emails in the **Config** and **Rubric** tabs - never in the nodes.
4. Knockout question wording lives in **Application Form** (answers are checked against Config).

## LANE 1b - AI Extraction & Rubric Scoring (v1.0)
**Skip duplicates → Read Rubric → ONE OpenRouter call (profile + 0-5 score per criterion with quoted evidence) → Code calculates weighted score & band → Update Candidates row → 1 Audit Log row per criterion**

_The AI never totals the score and never decides. Code does the math; every evidence quote is checked against the resume text; a human makes every decision. Model + temperature come from the Config tab._

## LANE 1c - Notifications (v1.0)
**Candidate acknowledgment + recruiter summary → Audit Log.** Duplicates skip AI and get a 'we already have your application' email; the recruiter gets a [DUPLICATE] alert.

_Candidate emails never mention scores, knockouts, or rejection. Only a human decides (Lane 2, v1.1)._

## LANE 4 - Error Alerts (v1.0)
**Any failed production run → read Config → email `error_alert_email` with the failed node, error and execution link → log ERROR to Audit Log.**

_Fires on production (published) runs only, not manual test runs. If the Config tab can't be read, the alert goes to FALLBACK_ALERT_EMAIL inside **Build Error Alert** (set this once at setup)._

parameters.jsCode:
// One Audit Log row per processed action
return $('Prepare Decision Updates').all().map(i => ({ json: i.json._audit }));

parameters.content:
## LANE 2 - Recruiter Decision + Interview Invite (Version 1)
**Every 2 min → read recruiter_decision (Advance / Hold / Reject) and interview_decision (Schedule Interview) in the Candidates tab → undo window (Config: decision_cooldown_minutes; 0 = send on first check) → send the Config email template (Advance carries the Stage 2 link, Schedule Interview carries the booking link) → set status → Audit Log.**

_decision_email_sent: PENDING:<decision> = in undo window · HOLD = on hold (can still change) · TRUE = final email sent, never re-sent. interview_status: PENDING → INVITED → BOOKED._

parameters.content:
## LANE 3 - Stage 2 Questionnaire (Version 1)
**Advance email carries a personal one-time link (cid + token) → link checked (right token, not used, not expired - Config stage2_link_expiry_days) → questions built from the Questionnaire tab → raw answers saved → AI scores each answer 0-5 with quoted evidence → code calculates questionnaire + combined score (Config weights) → Candidates + Audit Log → recruiter summary email.**

_AI never decides. Edit questions in the Questionnaire tab and settings in Config (STAGE2 rows) - not in these nodes._

parameters.content:
## LANE 5 - Interview Self-Booking (Version 1)
**Recruiter sets interview_decision = Schedule Interview (Lane 2 sends the personal booking link after the undo window) → link checked → free slots from Google Calendar (Config: hours, break, weekdays, buffer, notice) → candidate picks a time → slot re-checked (no double-booking) → Calendar event + Google Meet + invite → Candidates + Audit Log → recruiter email with 'verify in interview' points.**

_Rescheduling is manual in v1: the candidate replies to the invitation and the recruiter moves the event._
